conversation_messages.value: Your message, That is not straight forward in reality. the reason is that, LLMs work because due to vast asymmetry between the number of weights/params and number of self-supervised training examples(every sentence gives many training examples) the Multi-layer transformer architecture is FORCED to learn reusable computations, now generally more the data it sees and also multi-domain it may help it learn more reusable computations in the earlier layers, and make it more EFFECTIVE. so seeing multi-domain data also can help develop better capabilities in the early layers that help improve predictions across the domains, something which you could loose if you are training for a specific domain.
